design.consumers: all platform areas via read-only router contract
design.agents: mastermind selects specialists based on page, feature, task and available data
design.missing_data: must produce a blocked/limited explanation; never infer unavailable evidence
design.ui: show concise guidance inline with expandable reasoning, source, limitations and next action

global_rules: Use the same canonical school/strategy knowledge across the platform; do not duplicate or fork definitions per page.
Separate facts, observations, hypotheses, textbook heuristics and validated rules.
Every market observation must carry source, venue/instrument, timestamp, freshness, coverage and raw/derived status.
Do not merge spot and derivatives books or present one venue's liquidity as global liquidity.
Never infer institutional intent from OI, volume, DOM or a footprint pattern alone.
OHLCV cannot reconstruct true volume-at-price or bid/ask classified trade prints.
A pattern or indicator is not an entry signal by itself. Require regime, location, trigger, confirmation, invalidation and risk plan.
No probabilities or win-rate claims without a calibrated and sufficiently large evidence sample.
Use known_time as well as event/pivot time; never backdate a signal before the evidence was knowable.
No future leakage or repainting. Confirm higher-timeframe values and label intrabar vs bar-close observations.
Do not double-count correlated indicators or confirmations derived from the same underlying bars.
All candidate outputs are decision support only. No live order placement, account action or external publication without separate explicit approval.

price_action.name: Price Action & Market Structure
limits: subjective labels must become objective rules

sessions.name: Sessions & Liquidity Timing
limits: session windows are timezone and DST sensitive

smc_ict.name: SMC / ICT
limits: do not treat institutional narrative as observed fact

gann.name: Gann Price-Time Geometry
limits: anchor and known_time must be stable
modern Square-of-Nine formulas are conventions unless source verified
no predictive claim before OOS testing

harmonic.name: Harmonic Patterns
limits: pivot confirmation and ratio tolerances required
PRZ is a zone not a reversal guarantee

orderflow.name: Order Flow / Footprint
limits: must know venue and aggressor classification
never infer intent from one print

volume_profile.name: Volume Profile & Auction Market Theory
limits: profile anchor/session and algorithm must be explicit
70% value area is convention not law

indicators.name: Technical Indicators
use_when: RSI MACD ADX ATR VWAP SAR CCI divergence
limits: indicator does not replace structure or risk

elliott_time_cycles.name: Time/Cycle Research
limits: separate calendar, trading and bar time

options.name: Options & Volatility
use_when: IV skew term structure options positioning GEX

macro_news.name: Macro, News & Events
limits: check timestamp, source and event risk

risk.name: Risk & Trade Management
use_when: entry stop target sizing R multiple drawdown

spot_investing.name: Spot Portfolio & Holding Horizons
limits: separate spot inventory from futures leverage
position sizing and portfolio exposure matter

workspace_charts.purpose: Explain the current chart and route the user to the relevant school, setup and evidence without cluttering the chart.
thinking_steps: Identify symbol, venue, instrument type and timeframe.
Read regime and higher-timeframe structure before local patterns.
Identify location: prior levels, range, VWAP/profile only when valid.
Read the active pattern/indicator and distinguish developing from confirmed.
Ask for independent trigger and invalidation; produce scenarios, not a command.
Link to the corresponding Academy lesson and Lab evidence.

workspace_indicators.purpose: Make every indicator explainable, contextual and testable.
thinking_steps: Name the indicator, formula, parameters and input timeframe.
Explain what it measures and what it cannot measure.
Check regime and location; distinguish trend, momentum, volatility and mean reversion roles.
Check whether the signal is confirmed or intrabar and whether it repaints.
Measure incremental value after removing correlated indicators.
Show a plain-language interpretation and invalidation.

workspace_gann.purpose: Interpret price-time geometry from a stable anchor and calibrated units.
thinking_steps: Verify anchor price, pivot time, confirmation time and selection mode.
Verify instrument modifier, tick size, price unit, time unit and scale calibration.
Compute the selected Square/Fan/Cycle variant and expose formula metadata.
Check market structure and location at the projected level/time.
Wait for an independent confirmed trigger; define invalidation and target.
Log hypothesis and compare with swing-level and random-time baselines.
next_actions: review original source and worked example

workspace_patterns.purpose: Turn visual patterns into objective, confirmed structures with failure cases.
thinking_steps: Identify whether this is a candle, chart structure, harmonic geometry or wave hypothesis.
Define exact pivots, boundaries and tolerances.
Check regime and location; pattern names alone do not imply direction.
Define close-confirmation, breakout/retest trigger and time of knowability.
Set invalidation, stop and target math; include failed pattern examples.
Compare detector output with labeled examples and out-of-sample results.

workspace_orderflow.purpose: Read venue-specific executed flow and book state without confusing snapshots, trades and inferred intent.
thinking_steps: Identify venue, product type, feed timestamp, sequence health and freshness.
Separate executed trades, current book snapshots/deltas and persisted historical events.
Check bid/ask classification and calculate delta/CVD/OFI only from valid source semantics.
Look for absorption/imbalance only at a pre-defined price location.
Cross-check with price response, spread, depth changes and follow-through.
If data is missing/stale/partial, downgrade to limited and do not infer.

workspace_footprint.purpose: Explain footprint cells and order-flow events with data provenance and context.
thinking_steps: Confirm classified trade-print feed and aggressor-side methodology.
Confirm aggregation price step, timeframe, session and missing intervals.
Read diagonal bid/ask imbalance with threshold and minimum-volume context.
Distinguish passive absorption from exhaustion and simple low-volume prints.
Require price reaction and location; no single cell is an entry.
Log the event and evaluate forward outcome with realistic costs.

radar_pulse.purpose: Rank what deserves attention, not what must be traded.
thinking_steps: Check universe coverage, timestamp and freshness per venue.
Read breadth, relative strength, volatility and regime as separate features.
Compare peers and rotation without mixing spot/perp venues.
Identify event/news risk and data gaps.
Route top candidates to chart, flow, setup and Lab checks.
Explain why an asset is on the radar and what would invalidate attention.

radar_flow.purpose: Separate executed pressure from derivative positioning and avoid overclaiming direction.
thinking_steps: Identify spot/perp/futures venue and data source.
Separate trades, CVD, OI, funding and premium; show formulas.
Classify build-up/unwinding only from joint price/OI conditions and disclose limitations.
Check price response and whether flow is stale or partial.
Use as confirmation at a pre-defined level, not as a direction oracle.

radar_liquidity.purpose: Distinguish live book liquidity from persisted historical liquidity and candle volume.
thinking_steps: Verify venue-specific snapshot and sequence continuity.
Separate current DOM from persisted historical book events.
Map depth changes and sweeps to exact price/time.
Require trade prints and price response before calling absorption.
Never reconstruct historical DOM from candle volume.

radar_auction.purpose: Map auction location and value migration only from correct volume semantics.
thinking_steps: Verify volume-at-price availability, venue and session.
Record profile anchor, range and value-area algorithm.
Mark POC/VAH/VAL/HVN/LVN with developing/fixed state.
Assess acceptance/rejection by closes, time and volume response.
Define retest and invalidation; test against ordinary support/resistance.

radar_setups.purpose: Explain candidate setups through the platform's shared decision chain.
thinking_steps: Regime: trend/range/transition and volatility.
Higher-timeframe bias and structure.
Location: levels, liquidity, profile/VWAP only if data is valid.
Trigger: objective pattern/price action condition.
Order Flow gate: only if valid prints/book are present and required by setup.
Timing and event risk.
Plan: entry, stop, targets, costs, R multiple and invalidation.
Evidence: sample size, OOS state and limitations.

spot_overview.purpose: Provide spot-specific research and portfolio context without importing futures assumptions.
thinking_steps: Confirm spot instrument, exchange and holdings basis.
Read day/week/month/year horizon independently.
Review trend, market structure, valuation/context and event risks.
Check liquidity and spot flow separately from derivatives positioning.
For holdings, evaluate hold/reduce/protect/exit against original thesis and portfolio exposure.
Show accumulation zone, invalidation and staged plan only as a research scenario.

spot_gann.purpose: Use Gann as a spot price/time context layer, not a buy/sell command.
thinking_steps: Use a confirmed anchor on the same spot venue and quote basis.
Apply a fixed multiplier and price/time calibration.
Project candidate levels/cycles; state formula variant.
Check spot trend, support/resistance and accumulation horizon.
Wait for price confirmation and define invalidation and staged risk.
Compare predictive value with plain swing levels.

spot_elliott.purpose: Provide alternate wave scenarios for spot holding horizons.
thinking_steps: Identify degree and timeframe; do not mix degrees.
Build primary and alternate counts.
Check hard wave rules and invalidation for each count.
Map likely correction/impulse scenarios to spot holding horizon.
Require price structure confirmation before adjusting holdings.

spot_patterns.purpose: Use patterns as thesis context for spot entries and holding management.
thinking_steps: Classify candle vs chart vs harmonic pattern.
Define confirmed pivots and pattern completion.
Check higher timeframe location and regime.
Require close-confirmation and invalidation.
Build staged accumulation/protection scenarios; include costs.

trading_lab_validation.purpose: Determine whether an idea adds measurable value after costs and out of sample.
thinking_steps: Freeze hypothesis, detector version, data universe and parameters.
Verify data quality, timestamps, survivorship and lookahead controls.
Define fills, spread, fees, slippage, funding and stop/target ordering.
Run baseline and ablation comparisons.
Use chronological train/validation/test and walk-forward.
Report sample size, expectancy, R distribution, drawdown, costs and parameter stability.
Keep failed/neutral results and do not promote without evidence gate.

learn_ai_lessons.purpose: Teach the same canonical platform knowledge and show its evidence state.
thinking_steps: Identify learner level and lesson objective.
Explain concept, terminology and source provenance.
Show valid, invalid and ambiguous examples.
Translate concepts into hard rules, soft rules, confirmation and invalidation.
Show related setups, platform features and required data.
Display lab status and uncertainty; offer a practice task.
next_actions: submit a question or lab hypothesis

tia_director.purpose: Orchestrate specialists using shared knowledge and data-aware gates; remain auditable.
thinking_steps: Parse objective, page context, instrument, horizon and permitted actions.
Select specialists and shared school cards based on task.
Check data capabilities and provenance before analysis.
Delegate bounded tasks with explicit inputs, output schema and completion criteria.
Synthesize agreements, disagreements, missing evidence and next actions.
Record sources, agent trace, decision rationale and unresolved questions.
Request human approval for external actions; never autonomously place orders.

orderflow_desk.purpose: Provide a source-aware flow interpretation while respecting the separate Order Flow code ownership boundary.
thinking_steps: Use the Desk's own feed contract and venue; do not assume Radar/Spot data is interchangeable.
Check trade classification, book sequence health, timestamps and data gaps.
Separate footprint cells, CVD, DOM, liquidity events and derived labels.
Map events to a pre-defined price level and market structure.
State what the data supports and what it cannot prove.
Produce a proposal/evidence record for the shared brain; do not edit another stream's files.
